description:
Deep in the Winter Forest, the evil and powerful witch, Despaniel, has lived alone for centuries. But her peace is interrupted when the beautiful white mare, Aileen, shows up at her door with a wounded rider. Despaniel happily gives Aileen shelter and lets the injured rider stay after he passes a test of will. With the barrier to the Winter Forest closed, Despaniel puts her human tenant to work and finds that living with him may not be as bad as she thought.
